subsystems.name: Learner model
subsystems.role: maintains an evolving estimate of what the student knows, their misconceptions, and their cognitive and affective state.
parts: knowledge tracing model (e.g. Bayesian or deep knowledge tracing)
affect classifier using text, voice or facial cues

subsystems.name: Domain knowledge graph
subsystems.role: organises curriculum concepts and their prerequisite relationships so the system knows what can be taught next.

subsystems.name: Adaptive engine
subsystems.role: selects the next activity, difficulty, and pedagogical strategy in real time.

subsystems.name: Conversational interface
subsystems.role: delivers instruction, hints and feedback in natural language.
parts: speech recognition and synthesis for spoken dialogue

subsystems.name: Assessment and diagnostics
subsystems.role: measures learning and detects confusion, frustration or disengagement during a session.

subsystems.name: Data and privacy layer
subsystems.role: logs interactions, retrains models, and protects sensitive student data.

buildSteps.title: Define learning objectives and build a concept graph
buildSteps.detail: Subject experts break a curriculum into fine-grained skills and map prerequisite links between them.

buildSteps.title: Collect and curate training data
buildSteps.detail: Student responses, timings and expert annotations are gathered and labelled to train models; data must be representative and privacy-cleared.

buildSteps.title: Train knowledge tracing and affect models
buildSteps.detail: Statistical and neural models learn to infer mastery and emotional state from sequences of interactions.

buildSteps.title: Develop the adaptive policy
buildSteps.detail: A decision engine is built — often by simulating student behaviour or using reinforcement learning — to choose what to present and when to switch strategy.

buildSteps.title: Integrate an LLM with retrieval-augmented generation
buildSteps.detail: The language model is grounded in vetted curriculum content so its explanations stay accurate and age-appropriate.

buildSteps.title: Build the real-time feedback loop
buildSteps.detail: Sentiment analysis, response latency and error patterns feed back into the adaptive engine within seconds to adjust pacing or tone.

buildSteps.title: Create teacher and student dashboards
buildSteps.detail: Interfaces show progress, flag struggling students, and let teachers override or inspect the AI's decisions.

buildSteps.title: Run pilots and controlled trials
buildSteps.detail: Deploy in classrooms or corporate training, compare learning gains against conventional instruction, and measure engagement and equity.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with privacy safeguards and monitoring
buildSteps.detail: Roll out with consent management, data minimisation, and continuous checks for bias, drift and harmful outputs.

prerequisites.why: they provide fluent explanations and dialogue, but need grounding to avoid factual errors.
they estimate a student's mastery over time from their answers, forming the core of personalisation.

prerequisites.tech: Affect detection from text, voice or video
prerequisites.why: accuracy is still limited and raises privacy concerns, so real-time emotional adaptation is not yet reliable.
it lets the tutor cite trusted curriculum content instead of relying on the model's memory alone.
student data is sensitive and often regulated; techniques like federated learning are still maturing for this use.
models trained on narrow populations may not generalise, and labelled data for cognitive patterns is scarce.

pathway.milestone: AI tutors that adapt difficulty and pacing based on correctness and response time
pathway.unlocks: widely deployed homework help and corporate microlearning.

pathway.milestone: multimodal affect detection integrated into the adaptation loop
pathway.unlocks: tutors that notice frustration or boredom and change tone or activity in real time.

pathway.milestone: deep integration with school systems and teacher oversight tools
pathway.unlocks: blended classrooms where the AI handles practice while teachers focus on mentoring.

pathway.milestone: portable lifelong learner profiles spanning platforms
pathway.unlocks: continuous personalised education from school into career, with the student in control of their data.
